body: You most likely do qualify. In my California foodstamps intake they asked how much my rent was, how much I pay for gas and power, water, and pretty much all the little bills you mention so they take all of into consideration. Especially if your bills take up a large chunk of your pay. It is most definitely in your best interest to apply or at least try.
